make.name: Opel
make.description: German car maker founded by Adam Opel in Rüsselsheim in 1862, owned by General Motors until 2017, then PSA and, since 2021, Stellantis. In the UK the same cars are sold under the Vauxhall brand. Its electric line-up started with the Bolt-based Ampera-e (2017-2021) and now covers the Rocks Electric, Corsa, Mokka, Frontera, Astra and Grandland Electric plus Combo and Zafira people carriers.

models.name: Ampera-e
models.description: European version of the first Chevrolet Bolt EV, built by GM in Orion Township, Michigan and sold by Opel from 2017 (Norway first) until 2021 in small numbers (under 5,000 delivered in Europe by early 2019). Supply was cut after PSA bought Opel.

generations.name: Ampera-e
generations.description: Rebadged Bolt EV with a 60 kWh class battery; 520 km NEDC, 380 km WLTP.

models.name: Rocks Electric
models.description: Opel version of the Citroën Ami two-seat electric quadricycle (45 km/h, 5.5 kWh, 6 kW), presented in August 2021 and on sale from November 2021 in Germany, later also the Netherlands. Called Rocks-e until 2023.

generations.name: Rocks-e / Rocks Electric
generations.description: Identical to the Ami apart from colours and badges; built in Kenitra, Morocco.

models.name: Corsa Electric
models.description: Electric version of the sixth-generation (F) Corsa on the eCMP platform, launched as the Corsa-e in 2019/2020 with 50 kWh and 100 kW. Renamed Corsa Electric with the 2023 facelift, which added a 51 kWh / 115 kW version; a 207 kW Corsa GSE followed in September 2026. Sold as the Vauxhall Corsa Electric in the UK.

generations.name: Corsa F
generations.description: Corsa-e: 50 kWh (46.3 kWh usable), 100 kW, up to 357 km WLTP.

generations.name: Facelift
generations.description: Mid-2023 facelift with the Vizor front and the Corsa Electric name; 156 hp version (sold as "54 kWh" from 2025); GSE from September 2026.

models.name: Mokka Electric
models.description: Electric version of the second-generation (B) Mokka small SUV on eCMP, launched in early 2021 as the Mokka-e. A 54 kWh / 115 kW version replaced it from late 2023, the car was facelifted in late 2024 and a 207 kW GSE arrived in September 2025. Vauxhall Mokka Electric in the UK.

generations.name: Mokka B
generations.description: Mokka-e with 50 kWh / 100 kW; Mokka Electric 54 kWh / 115 kW from late 2023.

generations.name: Facelift
generations.description: Late-2024 facelift ("the all new Mokka" show cars); 54 kWh / 115 kW, plus the GSE from September 2025.

models.name: Astra Electric
models.description: Electric version of the sixth-generation (L) Astra, sold as a hatchback and Sports Tourer estate since 2023 on EMP2 V3. For model year 2026 (orders from early 2026) the battery grew from 54 kWh to 58 kWh. Vauxhall Astra Electric in the UK.

generations.name: Astra L
generations.description: 54 kWh (50.8 kWh usable) and 115 kW, shared with the Peugeot e-308.

generations.name: 2026 update
generations.description: Model-year 2026 update with a 58.3 kWh (55.4 kWh usable) battery and up to 454 km WLTP.

models.name: Grandland Electric
models.description: Electric version of the second-generation Grandland, revealed on 22 April 2024 and built in Eisenach on STLA Medium. Launched with 73 kWh and 82 kWh batteries; the 82 kWh version was replaced by a 97 kWh one in late 2025, and a 239 kW AWD version was added in mid-2025. Vauxhall Grandland Electric in the UK.

generations.name: Second generation Grandland
generations.description: STLA Medium; built in Eisenach, Germany.

models.name: Frontera Electric
models.description: Electric version of the 2024 Frontera, a low-cost B-SUV on the Smart Car platform with five or seven seats, sold since mid-2024 with a 44 kWh LFP battery; a 54 kWh Extended Range version followed in July 2025. Vauxhall Frontera Electric in the UK.

generations.name: Frontera C
generations.description: Smart Car platform, LFP batteries, 83 kW motor.

models.name: Combo Electric
models.description: Electric passenger version of the fifth-generation Combo (Combo Life), sold from late 2021 as the Combo-e Life and from 2024, after the facelift, as the Combo Electric. Twin of the Citroën ë-Berlingo and Peugeot e-Rifter; Vauxhall Combo Life Electric in the UK.

generations.name: Facelift
generations.description: 2024 facelift with the Vizor front and a revised 50 kWh battery (up to 345 km WLTP).

models.name: Zafira Electric
models.description: Electric version of the Zafira Life people carrier (Vivaro-based, up to nine seats), sold from late 2020 as the Zafira-e Life with 50 kWh or 75 kWh and 100 kW; renamed Zafira Electric with the 2024 facelift. Sold as the Vauxhall Vivaro Life Electric in the UK. Twin of the Citroën ë-SpaceTourer and Peugeot e-Traveller.

generations.name: Zafira Life
generations.description: 50 kWh (231 km WLTP) or 75 kWh (329 km WLTP), 100 kW.

generations.name: Facelift
generations.description: 2024 facelift with the Vizor front and the Zafira Electric name.
